purpose: Teach: 親しま/似通っ/嗚呼/取り敢えず/ながめ/きびしい/ようするに/よーく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のクラス、みんなに親しまれてんな
lines.en: Riku, your whole class really gravitates toward you, doesn't it?
lines.style: Warm observation with a slight tease. Light, easy delivery. Noticing something she genuinely thinks is cool about him, not making it weird.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、俺と趣味似通ってんな、桜
lines.en: Your taste in things is weirdly similar to mine, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet realization. A bit self-conscious admitting it. Soft delivery, like he's not expecting her to care. Slight pause before her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、嗚呼、また宿題忘れたな
lines.en: Riku, didn't you forget your homework again?
lines.style: Dry, knowing tone. The cadence of someone who's caught him in the same mistake twice. Quick, almost exasperated affection underneath the wry surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、取り敢えず先生に謝れよ、桜
lines.en: Just apologize to the teacher first, okay Sakura?
lines.style: Practical advice, gently offered. Not lecturing—just pointing the obvious path forward. Steady, reliable tone. A little protective without being patronizing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、空ばっか、ながめてんなよ
lines.en: Riku, you're always just staring up at the sky like that.
lines.style: Half-affectionate, half-exasperated observation. A hint of 'I see you doing this and I'm calling you out but gently.' Slight laugh underneath the words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、きびしいよな、桜
lines.en: Your dad can be pretty strict, can't he Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment of something real. Not prying, just—seeing her. Slow, thoughtful pace. The tone of someone who notices when something weighs on someone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ようするに、お前は勉強したいんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, so you actually do want to study, don't you?
lines.style: Curious, gently pressing. Testing a theory she's had about him. Warm but direct—not accusatory, just—asking the real question underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、よーくやってみろよ、桜
lines.en: Just give it a real try, okay?
lines.style: Sincere encouragement. No irony here. Quiet conviction. The shift in her voice when she actually means something, not performing. Steady eye contact in the voice.
